title: Machine failure
note: PUBLISHED-SYNTHETIC data (not real) — failure=1. AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset — DOI 10.24432/C5HS5C, CC BY 4.0: NOT real measurements — its authors publish it as a SYNTHETIC dataset that reflects real predictive-maintenance data, because real data is hard to obtain and publish (10,000 simulated milling operations). Held-out = by operation order (UDI), case mix 10.00% positive (population 3.39%); grown only on the training split.
lineage: Grown by tools/build-real-brains.mjs with src/grow.mjs growPattern — the seed-library ribosome (sjgant80-hub/seed-library, vendored) — on the training split only, graded once on the held-out split. Pattern shape and answer path: the Konomi SLM (sjgant80-hub/konomi-slm). Konomi architecture: Thomas Frumkin.

provenance.citation: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2020. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5HS5C — introduced in S. Matzka, "Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Predictive Maintenance Applications", 2020 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Industries (AI4I), DOI 10.1109/AI4I49448.2020.00023
provenance.label: failure=1: the operation ended in a machine failure (the published "Machine failure" flag: any of tool wear, heat dissipation, power, overstrain or random failure)
provenance.split: by operation order (UDI) — operations 1–7,000 are the training split, 7,001–10,000 the held-out split
